description: Post-AC-4 cross-cell variance trajectory for the 5-cell admitted activation cohort. Re-emitted after AC-4.1 / AC-4.2 / AC-4.3 / AC-4.4 / AC-4.5 sub-slices closed in Rounds 3-9 of this RLCR session. The cross-cell prediction stddev (ddof=1 over the 5 per-cell predicted_hit_rate values) is the load-bearing AC-6 input. The 0.10 threshold is the DEC-2 / DEC-4 floor adjudicated at loop bootstrap (Round 0); when the post-AC-4 stddev falls below this floor, the calibration head must NOT be applied per AC-6's fail-closed contract.

verdict_rationale: The 5-cell admitted activation cohort exhibits cross-cell prediction stddev = 0.01833, which is more than 5x below the 0.10 floor documented in the plan's AC-6 spec. Under DEC-2 (typed_unavailable on precondition failure), the cache_predictor's variance-precondition gate (added in this round at workloads/simbench_bw/cache_predictor.py) emits result_kind='typed_unavailable' with typed_reason='calibration_variance_precondition_failed' AND headline_validity_failed_reasons=['calibration_variance_precondition_failed'] when the gate kwarg is set + falls below 0.10. The existing committed refreshed sweep at data/sm_86_predictor_accuracy_recovery/refreshed_sweep_round_3/predictor_bundles/ remains scalar (the gate was added after the sweep was emitted; the default-off behavior preserves it byte-for-byte for back-compat). Any future sweep regenerated with the gate enabled (e.g., the AC-8 final sm_86 sweep in a later round) MUST emit the fail-closed typed-unavailable bundles per this AC-6 verdict.
narrative: The 5-cell admitted cohort consists of pointwise + per-row-reduction activation kernels whose predicted_hit_rate values cluster tightly between 0.9375 (silu correctness + silu timing — both saturating to the modeled-hit ceiling for the no-write-allocate-filtered observations) and 0.9771 (layernorm timing). This narrow spread reflects two structural properties: (a) all 5 kernels operate on tensor working sets that fit comfortably within the GA102 L2 capacity (1 MB per slice; 6 MB total) so the Maeda HRD second-layer hit decision is trivially satisfied for every per-launch access; (b) the AC-4.3 write-policy filter removes the ~6-27% shared-memory store fraction uniformly across the 3 reduction-heavy kernels (layernorm/rmsnorm/softmax) without altering the silu kernels' all-global-store output. The post-AC-4 cohort thus has insufficient cross-cell signal to fit a calibration head's per-cell residual transform without overfitting on the 5-sample cohort. The plan's AC-6 contract requires the typed_unavailable fail-closed verdict in this case; this artifact records that verdict honestly. To improve the cross-cell variance signal, the cohort would need expansion with synthetic canary cells whose working sets exceed the L2 capacity (rejected per the loop-bootstrap DEC-1 = `Formal closure` adjudication) OR with a richer real-kernel corpus including tiled GEMM / stencil / cross-launch-state-exercising kernels — both out of scope for the present loop's sm_86 activation-only research framing.
